npcs.name: Elder Maren
lines: The mountain burned before you were born. We rebuilt the village; the monsters rebuilt too.
The gate to the Ashen Mountain is north, past the bridge. Ten floors of teeth and worse manners.
And if you beat the dragon... come see me. There are older things below. I hear them some nights.
ashesLines: Fafnyr came down off the mountain and the village burned in one night. We are what's left.
Odo, Hilda and Vex trade from the square until they have roofs again. Sela keeps a tent for anyone who needs a bed.
The mayor's ledger survived. Rebuild us, and then - then we go up that mountain.

lines: You came up the road as the fire came down the mountain. Who are you?
(You hand her the letter.) Vellmar's seal. I wrote to them three times.
(She reads it twice.) Then no one is coming.
(She looks up at the mountain for a long time.) Rest. We'll talk at dawn.

npcs.name: Ana
lines: The merchant waters down his elixirs, I swear it. Buy the cheese instead.
Stay on the roads if you value your ankles. The tufty grass BITES.

npcs.name: Bram
lines: I saw a wolf take a whole cheese wheel off a traveler once. Rolled it away and everything.
Me? Climb the mountain? I have a perfectly good fence to lean on right here.
(A man lies pinned under a burning beam. You put your shoulder to it. It shifts - then rolls away.)
The beam - you got it off - thank you. Thank you. I'm Bram. I'll live, I think. Probably.
Sela's set up a tent on the square for the hurt. Go. I'll follow when my legs remember how.

npcs.name: Merchant Odo
lines: Welcome, welcome! Finest goods this side of the mountain. The counter is always open.

npcs.name: Smith Hilda
lines: The forge takes gold, not promises. Bring me a blade and coin and I will make both sharper.
Seven folds is the most any steel will take. After that it is the arm, not the iron.

npcs.name: Alchemist Vex
lines: Herbs, reeds, shards - I pay full price for reagents. The wilds are a garden if you survive them.
The elixir recipe? One of each, child. Nature likes a balanced potion.

npcs.name: Innkeeper Sela
lines: Ten gold for a bed and no questions. The bards say my stew brought a man back from the brink.
It was the stew or the poultice. Probably the stew.
Sit. You're bleeding and you haven't even noticed. ... There.
I'm Sela. I kept the inn, when there was an inn. Now I keep a tent and more hurt than I have cloth for.
Maren's at the shrine. She's the elder - she'll want to know who you are, walking in out of the fire.

npcs.name: Mayor Aldric
lines: Pixelheim runs on two things: stubbornness and gold. The first we have. Bring the second to my ledger.
Every coin you invest, the town wears. Come back and see.
ashesLines: The hall stood. Stone does that. Everything else is cinders and stubbornness.
The board on the square lists what we need to rebuild. Coin and a little from the wilds - we'll do the rest.

npcs.name: Mira the Weaver
lines: I came for the market stalls. Stayed for the lamplight. This place is going somewhere.
A village that pays its own way - the mayor talks about you, you know.

3: The fountain brought buyers from the valley. My looms can't keep up.
A village that pays its own way became a town that pays its weavers.
4: Banners on every street. Guess who wove them.
The mayor talks about you. Everyone does now.

npcs.name: Old Tomas
lines: A fountain! I hauled water forty years and now it leaps out of the ground on its own.
New roofs going up everywhere. My grandson has a TRADE now. A trade!

4: Lamps to the mountain gate! I walked it last night just to see. Twice.
My grandson has a trade AND a house. A house!

npcs.name: Serra
lines: A city under the Ashen Mountain. My mother would not believe the streetlights.
They say the one who paid for all this walks around in plain armor. Imagine that.

npcs.name: Fenn
lines: Paved streets! My cart has never rolled so smooth.
I sell to the merchants here now. City prices, friend. City prices.

npcs.name: The cat
lines: The cat looks at you, then at your boots, then away. You have been judged.

npcs.name: The dog
lines: The dog leans its whole weight on your leg and sighs, very content.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Are you the one who fights the monsters? I fight monsters too. Mostly the goose.

npcs.name: Nell
lines: Tag! You're it! ...You're not going to chase me, are you. Grown-ups never chase.

recruits.name: Iva the Healer
meetLines: Careful in the fen. I patch up what it bites, but I am running out of reeds to bind with.
A town with a shrine and no healer... bring me three marsh reeds and I will set up beside it.
recruits.askLine: Three marsh reeds, and my tent moves to Pixelheim.
recruits.joinedLine: Reeds enough to start with. Find me by the shrine - and come to me before you climb.
townLines: Sit. Breathe. There - whole again. My door is always open to the town's patron.
The shrine hums some nights. Good company for a healer.
recruits.perk: Iva heals you whole, free, whenever you're in town

2: The lamps help. People come to me before dark now, not after.
3: A fountain by the square and clean water at last. Half my work was the water.
4: A city needs a hospice. I've asked the mayor. He said 'after the flower beds'.

recruits.perkUp: Iva heals you whole, free, whenever you're in town, and tops your healing potions up to three

recruits.name: Loras the Bard
meetLines: A bard in a forest sings to trees. Trees, friend, do not tip.
Get me an audience with lamplight and I will make your battles sound like legends. 150 gold - relocation is art too.
recruits.askLine: 150 gold, and my lute follows you home.
recruits.tierLine: Sing for a hamlet? Darling, no. Light some lamps first - make Pixelheim a village, then we talk.
recruits.joinedLine: A patron! Pixelheim gains its first verse tonight.
townLines: A song before you march! There - carry that fire into the fight, it sharpens the blade's edge.
I am composing 'The Ballad of the Ashen Patron'. It needs a triumphant ending. No pressure.
recruits.perk: Loras plays a marching song before a hunt: +12% crit until it ends

3: 'The Ballad of the Ashen Patron', verse nine: the fountain. It rhymes with mountain, which is a gift.
A song before you march! Carry that fire into the fight.
4: A city deserves an anthem. I have the tune. I need the ending - Morvax's, ideally.
A song before you march! Carry that fire into the fight.

recruits.perkUp: Loras plays a marching song with a war-horn before a hunt: +20% crit until it ends

recruits.name: Wren the Stablemaster
meetLines: Lost my stable to the ash years back. Been walking travelers' horses by the gate ever since.
Two wolf pelts for saddle leather and I will run a proper post in town - straight to the square, no gate queue.
recruits.askLine: Two wolf pelts for the saddles, and the stable is Pixelheim's.
recruits.joinedLine: Leather enough! The post stands by the north road - the square is a whistle away now.
townLines: The post runs like a dream. Fast travel drops you right at the square now - no gate queue.
Horses hate the ash fields. Smart animals.
recruits.perk: Wren's post: travel to the town gate lands you on the square

3: The fountain spooks the young horses. They'll learn. So did I.
Fast travel to the gate drops you on the square - my post runs like a dream.
4: Lamps all the way to the mountain gate. I ride the night shift for fun now.
Fast travel to the gate drops you on the square - my post runs like a dream.

recruits.perkUp: Wren's post: travel to the town gate lands you on the square, and you walk a tenth faster above ground

recruits.name: Mirelle the Banker
meetLines: I count coins for caravans that never stop anywhere worth banking in.
Give me a town with a fountain and 500 gold of founding capital, and I will make Pixelheim's money WORK.
recruits.askLine: 500 gold of founding capital, and the bank follows you home.
recruits.tierLine: A bank needs a TOWN, not a village fair. Grow Pixelheim into a town and we will talk.
recruits.joinedLine: Capital received. Find my ledger by the city hall - bring your idle gold.
townLines: Idle gold is lazy gold. Savings, a caravan, an expansion - put it to work.
The mayor builds with your gold. I make it come BACK. We are not the same.
recruits.perk: Mirelle's bank: savings that grow, caravans and expansions

4: City prices, city deposits. Pixelheim's gold finally comes back to Pixelheim.
Idle gold is lazy gold. Savings, a caravan, an expansion - put it to work.

recruits.perkUp: Mirelle's bank: savings that grow 3% a day, caravans and expansions

cleared: You came back from {floor}? Everyone said nobody comes back from there.
{floor}, was it? My uncle went down there once. Once.
boss: The whole town heard about {boss}. Bram's telling it like he was there.
Is it true about {boss}? You look... normal. I expected taller.
project: Have you seen the {project}? Of course you have - you paid for it.
The {project}! I walked past it three times this morning.
settler: {settler} moved in! Pixelheim is filling up again.
Did you hear? {settler} is one of us now.
hunt: They say you killed {beast}. I'll believe it when I see the head. ...Oh. That's the head.
{beast}, gone! My mother won't believe it. I barely believe it.

festivalBarker.name: Barker Jory
lines: Roll up, roll up! Three rings, three pegs - land two and the prize is yours!
Free to play on a festival day. The mayor's paying, so throw as often as you like.
